[[Silver Spring, Maryland]] }} '''Dante Cunningham''' (born April 22, 1987) is an American [[college basketball]] player. Cunningham, a [[power forward]], attends [[Villanova Wildcats basketball|Villanova University]] in [[Pennsylvania]]. ==Early life== Cunningham was born on April 22, 1987 in Clinton, Maryland, to Searcy Blakenship and Ron Cunningham. His older sister [[Davalyn Cunningham|Davalyn]] used to play in the [[WNBA]].{{cite web|url=http://www.villanova.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/cunningham_dante00.html|title=Dante Cunningham Profile|date=2009|publisher=CBS Interactive|work=Villanova.com|accessdate=2009-03-29}} ==High school== Cunningham was originally educated at St. John's High School in [[Washington, D.C.]] While a junior, he averaged 10 points per game and 7.4 rebounds. One of his teammates, [[Dwayne Anderson]], would later play at Villanova with Cunningham. As a senior, Cunningham transferred to Potomac High School, which he led to a 27-0 season. He averaged 13 rebounds, 20 points, and four blocked shots per game at Potomac. He was honored as the Washington Post Metropolitan Player of the Year. ==College== ===Freshman=== At [[Villanova University]], Cunningham played in all 33 games and was a starter in four during his freshman year. ===Senior=== Cunningham would go on to lead the team in scoring and take home the [[Big East Most Improved Player]] award. ==References== {{reflist}} {{US-basketball-bio-stub}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Cunningham, Dante}} [[Category:1987 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:African American basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball players from Maryland]] [[Category:People from Silver Spring, Maryland]] [[Category:Forwards (basketball)]] [[Category:Villanova Wildcats men's basketball players]]
